question: Why does the realized seer perceive all comings and goings as pervaded by Shiva?
premises: All comings and goings are pervaded by Shiva.
The realized seer directly perceives the Shiva-principle.
That Shiva-principle is seen as undivided true being.
inference: Because reality is undividedly Shiva, every movement is seen as Shiva-filled by the realized seer.
uncertainties: The verse moves quickly from ontology to vision; the causal link is implied rather than spelled out.
plain_english: Because all comings and goings are filled with Shiva, the realized person sees the Shiva-principle as undivided true being.
